title: Serving Netflix Video at 400Gbps on FreeBSD by Drew Gallatin
summary: Netflix engineer Drew Gallatin explains how Netflix serves TLS-encrypted video at 400Gb/s from a single FreeBSD server. He covers NUMA, kernel TLS, hardware TLS offload and the memory bandwidth and PCIe bottlenecks they hit.
why: HN cites it as a prime example of FreeBSD tuned for extreme network performance at massive scale.

quote.text: being actively used to run the largest streaming service on the planet makes you pretty relevant.
